messages:
people-ops: Sharing a tiny 'Career Signal Cards' pack  short prompts managers and ICs can use to make promotion conversations concrete. Copy-pasteables only. :sparkles:

people-ops: Card 1 - One-line impact (for self-review):
"I delivered <outcome> which moved <metric> by <x%>, and I mentored <n> peers to reduce onboarding time by <y%>."

people-ops: Card 2 - Evidence bundle (paste into calibration):
- PRs: <link1>, <link2>
- Dashboards: <panel link>
- Decision log: <link>

people-ops: Card 3 - Manager probe (30s):
```
Manager: "Tell me the toughest tradeoff you made on this work and why. What would you do differently next time?"
IC: "Chose X over Y to hit latency SLO; learned we needed earlier infra involvement; will add a pre-commit checklist."
```

people-ops: Card 4 - Quick readiness check (yes/no style):
- Clear owner? yes/no
- Metric defined? yes/no
- Artifacts available? yes/no
- Cross-team influence? yes/no

marco: Can we get a version for ICs to prompt peers for async feedback?

people-ops: Sure  Peer ask snippet: "Two-line favor: can you give 1 sentence on impact and 1 sentence on collaboration for my work on <project>? Example: "Improved search latency 18%, and proactively coordinated infra rollout."

jen: Toss in a 10-min promo-readiness checklist managers can use before calibration?

people-ops: Done  10-min pre-calibration checklist:
- 2m: Confirm candidate goals + metrics
- 3m: Scan artifacts (PRs / dash) for signal strength
- 3m: Note leadership evidence (mentorship, cross-team ops)
- 2m: Recommend: ready / needs stretch / not ready + one sentence rationale

talent-ops-bot: note: saved to Confluence at /people-ops/career-signal-cards (org-restricted).

marco: Love it. Short, useful, will send to my PMs.

jen: Saved. Will include in our promo prep doc. :thumbsup:
